faqs.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faqs.description: Quick answers to common sourcing questions.

items.question: What is your minimum order quantity (MOQ)?
items.answer: The minimum order quantity is 500 pieces. Final color and design allocation is confirmed with the quotation.

items.question: Can you customize our logo and design?
items.answer: Yes. We support custom artwork, fabrics, labels, hardware and packaging through our OEM/ODM workflow.

items.question: How long does sample development take?
items.answer: Sampling lead time is confirmed after the design and materials are agreed.

items.question: What are your main export markets?
items.answer: We work with buyers in the Middle East, Latin America and other global markets.

items.question: How do you ensure product quality?
items.answer: Our process includes material checks, in-line production inspection and final quality control before packing.
